question: Where was the Indian flag hoisted for the 79th Independence Day celebrations?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Seattle Space Needle**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Indian Flag Hoisted on Seattle’s Space Needle for 79th Independence Day.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Indian tricolour** was hoisted at **Seattle’s 605-feet-tall Space Needle**.

 
 
• 
 
Event marked **India’s 79th Independence Day celebrations** abroad.

 
 
• 
 
First time a **foreign nation’s flag** was raised at this **popular US landmark**.

 
 
• 
 
**Consul General Prakash Gupta** and **Seattle Mayor Bruce Harrell** attended.

 
 
• 
 
Space Needle, built in **1962** for the **World Fair**, symbolizes **Seattle’s skyline** and **tech-driven future**.
